units.previous_finding: Source comment: Crawl uses fetcher to recursively crawl pages starting with url, to a maximum of depth. Current Filipino: Ginagamit ng Crawl ang fetcher upang paulit-ulit na i-crawl ang mga pahina simula sa url, hanggang sa pinakamataas na depth. The phrase paulit-ulit na i-crawl describes repeated crawling, not recursive traversal. The Go code recursively calls Crawl(u, depth-1, fetcher) for discovered URLs, and the exercise separately requires not fetching a URL twice. Revise the natural-language comment to express recursion explicitly while retaining the start URL, maximum depth, identifiers, all code, and the original comment structure.
